name: ERA5
producer: ECMWF for the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S)

name: MERRA-2
full_name: Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2
producer: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO); distributed by GES DISC

name: CPC Unified Gauge Analysis
full_name: CPC Unified Gauge-Based Analysis of Global Daily Precipitation

name: GPCC Monthly
producer: Global Precipitation Climatology Centre (GPCC), Deutscher Wetterdienst
version: Version 2025 (successor of Full Data Monthly V2022; now merged with the former Monitoring Product)

name: GPCP Monthly
full_name: Global Precipitation Climatology Project (GPCP) Monthly Climate Data Record, Version 2.3
producer: GPCP (University of Maryland / NASA GSFC) for the NOAA Climate Data Record program

name: IMERG
full_name: Integrated Multi-satellitE Retrievals for GPM (IMERG), Version 07
producer: NASA Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) mission; distributed by GES DISC

coverage: Global oceans; January 1850 to present; monthly; 5°

full_name: NOAA 0.25° Daily Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature (OISST), Version 2.1

name: IBTrACS
full_name: International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship, Version 4 (v04r01)

name: GHCN-CAMS
